name: IBY_ROUTINGINFO
description: IBY_ROUTINGINFO stores information that maps payment method to the payment system and funds capture process profile via conditions.

columns.name: PAYEEID
columns.description: Payee Identifier passed by electronic commerce application

columns.name: BEPID
columns.description: Payment system Identifier

columns.name: PAYMENTMETHODID
columns.description: System-generated identifier of the payment method

columns.name: CONFIGURED
columns.description: Indicates whether payment method is active or not. 1 is active and 0 is inactive.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Order in which the payment methods are selected

columns.name: PAYMENTMETHODNAME
columns.description: Name of the payment method

columns.name: MPAYEEID
columns.description: Payee Identifier

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Used in hosted environments

columns.name: INSTR_TYPE
columns.description: Instrument type for which this routing rule applies. One of CREDITCARD, PURCHASECARD, or BANKACCOUNT

columns.name: INSTR_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: If INSTR_TYPE is BANKACCOUNT, subtype can be either ACH or BR

columns.name: BEPKEY
columns.description: Merchant account Identifier associated with this routing rule

columns.name: HITCOUNTER
columns.description: Count of the number of times the routing rule was chosen

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Inactive Date

columns.name: FNDCPT_USER_PROFILE_CODE
columns.description: Funds capture process profile

columns.name: PAYMENT_CHANNEL_CODE
columns.description: Payment method

columns.name: BEP_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Payment system account

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the routing rule is available for use

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date until which the routing rule is available for use

columns.name: TOKENIZATION_ROUTING_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether the routing rule is for transaction or payment instrument tokenization.
